name: pont Saint-Michel
text: Pont Saint-Michel (French pronunciation: [pɔ̃ sɛ̃ miʃɛl]) is a bridge linking the Place Saint-Michel on the left bank of the river Seine to the Île de la Cité. It was named after the nearby chapel of Saint-Michel. It is near Sainte Chapelle and the Palais de Justice.

depictions.name: Pont Saint-Michel
depictions.text: The Pont Saint-Michel is a bridge in Paris, France that links the southern bank of the Seine with the Île de la Cité.
